summary: Resolved 3/6 in-scope sorry instances, fixed all compilation errors (6 errors across 3 files), fixed critical ClosureCondition instance resolution bug in Expansion.lean. Remaining 3 sorry are structural blockers requiring infrastructure changes (loop induction over let rec, worldOf architecture redesign).

Cslib/Logics/Propositional/Tableau/Class: classicalTableau_sound (line 515) — loop induction over fuel-based let rec expansion
Cslib/Logics/Propositional/Tableau/Intui: intRule_preserves_sat F(imp) case (line 162) — worldOf architecture: lemma requires fixed worldOf but F(imp) creates new world needing existential witness
intuitionisticTableau_sound (line 244) — loop induction over fuel-based let rec expansion

blockers.description: Main soundness theorems (classicalTableau_sound, intuitionisticTableau_sound) require induction over fuel-based expansion loops implemented as let rec inside intExpandBranches/classicalExpandBranches. Lean 4 structural recursion on let rec is non-trivial.
blockers.resolution: Extract expansion loop as top-level well-founded recursive function, or prove a loop invariant lemma separately

blockers.description: intRule_preserves_sat F(imp) case: the lemma quantifies over all worldOf functions, but the F(imp) rule creates world nw whose image worldOf(nw) must equal the existential witness w' from ¬IForces(φ→ψ). The lemma signature is too strong for this case.
blockers.resolution: Either (a) change lemma to return ∃ worldOf', ... allowing worldOf update, or (b) fold F(imp) handling into the main soundness theorem where the model construction controls worldOf, or (c) add hypothesis that worldOf is updatable
